headline: Peter Sommer Travels: Expert-led Cultural Tours and Gulet Cruises
primaryText: 14 days uncovering Crete’s iconic past, gastronomic delights and rugged beauty, in small groups with expert archaeologist guides. The ultimate Greek island experience awaits.
description: Crete, Beyond the Beaches | Walk Through Ancient Civilisations | Taste the Island’s Living Traditions | Travel With True Cultural Experts
whyItWorks: The carousel shows real small groups standing at ancient sites, so a prospect can picture themselves on the trip. Each card pairs one angle (history, food, expert guides) with a short serif title, letting different motivations land in a single swipe. The pitch of expert archaeologist guides and small groups appeals to curious, older travellers who want depth over beach holidays, and the ad has run for months, which suggests it converts.
